senses.example: Se pone el pañuelico el seis de julio.
senses.exampleGloss: He puts on the San Fermín neckerchief on the sixth of July.

alternatives.reason: The ordinary cloth, not the festival neckerchief.
A different part of the San Fermín outfit.

notes: el pañuelico is the red neckerchief tied at the neck during San Fermín.
